short: Tracking table status so the floor is used efficiently.
seoTitle: Table Management — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: Tracking table status so the floor is used efficiently. Empty tables that nobody knows are empty are the most common cause of a queue at the door.
definition: Table management tracks the state of every table — free, seated, ordered, billed, being cleared — so hosts can seat parties quickly and servers can see what needs attention.
bodyHtml:
Why Table Management matters

Empty tables that nobody knows are empty are the most common cause of a queue at the door. Visibility, not capacity, is usually the constraint on a busy evening.

How Table Management works in practice

Keep status updates part of the service flow rather than a separate task, and match party size to table size. Seating a couple at a six-top on a Saturday costs real covers.

faq.question: How does table management increase revenue?
faq.answer: By raising turnover — faster seating and clearing produce more covers from the same floor.

faq.question: Is it useful for a small restaurant?
faq.answer: Below about fifteen tables the host usually holds it in their head; beyond that, a system pays for itself.
